name: step08-a-ranking-uncertainty
title: A: Model Ranking Uncertainty (paired bootstrap CI)
description: Compute paired-difference bootstrap CIs for RMSE / MAE / weighted RMSE and pairwise RMSE differences across the 5 strict-primary global models. Report ranking stability and GEBCO-vs-ETOPO significance. Use 10-degree block bootstrap. Inputs are Stage 3 by-cell residuals; no model resampling.
creator: Ruichen Zhou
